285:Established in 1988, JD Institute of Fashion Technology, the multiple
286:award-winning Design Institute with 38+ learning centers across India,
287-is nurturing masterminds from all over India to translate their dreams
288:into success. Since its inception, the Institute has carved a niche in
289:the field of design education and has metamorphosed into an industry
290-leader that develops courses with a pulse on the needs of the industry.
291:To cater to the ever-growing market, JD Institute offers a plethora of
292:courses in the field of Fashion Design, Interior Design, Jewellery
293:Design, Fashion Communication, Fashion and Lifestyle Entrepreneurship,
294:Fashion Business Management, Visual Merchandising, Fashion Photography,
295-and Hair and Make-up Artistry. With the aid of a vigorous combination of
296-Research, Mentoring, Practical exposure, and Class-room training, the
297:Institute plays a key role in shaping the students to become the
298-industry experts of tomorrow.

300:JD Institute of Fashion Technology as the educational division of JD
301:Educational Trust, is one of the oldest and premiere institute of art
302-and design in India The exciting journey began with Mr. Chandraakant
303-Dalal (President) whose passion and dedication led to the expansion of
304:the Institute across different cities in India and Mr. R.C Dalal
305:(Co-founder) an iconic pioneer in the field of fashion and art
306:education. Advancing the dreams and aspirations of the visionaries, the
307-rich legacy is taken forward by Mr. Nealesh Dalal, Managing Trustee, JD
